Article Title: Al-Qaida offshoot AQIS behind Red Fort blast in 2025: UNSC report confirms
Article Text:
11 people were killed in the blast on November 10, 2025

(With ANI inputs)

NEW DELHI: The United Nations Security Council (UNSC) has officially attributed the November 2025 blast near Delhi’s iconic Red Fort to Al-Qaida in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS), according to the 38th report of its Analytical Support and Sanctions Monitoring Team.The attack on November 10 last year claimed 11 lives."Al-Qaida in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS, not listed) continued to evolve from a fragmented group into a regional terrorist entity; it established logistics and financial networks, working in decentralised, small, scattered cells instead of large units. The attack in November 2025 on the Red Fort in Delhi was officially attributed to AQIS," the report, published on August 10, stated.The assessment marks a significant shift in the attribution of the Red Fort attack, which had earlier been linked to the Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM).The report noted that one member state had attributed a series of attacks to JeM and also linked the group to the Red Fort blast.The explosion occurred around 7 pm when a moving Hyundai i20 erupted in flames near the iconic monument.Investigators identified Umar-e-Nabi as the driver of the car and suspect him of carrying out the attack as a suicide bomber.Read also: Red Fort blast: 7,500-page NIA charge sheet alleges ‘Operation Heavenly Hind’ to overthrow govt Launched in 2014, AQIS is a regional affiliate of Al-Qaida.The group was formed to expand the organisation’s activities across South Asia, including India, Pakistan, Bangladesh and parts of Afghanistan.Meanwhile, the latest UNSC assessment also flagged broader concerns over the activities and capabilities of Al-Qaida and Islamic State (ISIL/Da’esh) affiliates.The report noted that Al-Qaida and ISIL had for years shown interest in developing chemical and biological weapons but had so far failed to overcome the technical challenges involved. It also highlighted the widespread circulation of instructions on producing such agents in online terrorist communities.The report cited material published by ISIL’s English-language Invade magazine in February that included instructions related to botulinum toxin and cyanide. It also noted that ISIL-K had shown particular interest in ricin and circulated instructions on developing the toxin over the previous 12 months.
Article Summary: The United Nations Security Council has officially attributed the November 2025 blast near Delhi’s iconic Red Fort to Al-Qaida in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS) The assessment marks a significant shift in the attribution of the Red Fort attack, which had earlier been linked to the Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM)

Article Title: 'Why Bhagwa Dhwaj over Tricolour?': Priyank Kharge targets BJP, RSS over Har Ghar Tiranga campaign
Article Text:

NEW DELHI: Karnataka home minister Priyank Kharge on Thursday targeted the BJP over its ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign, saying it should begin at the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh ( RSS ) headquarters in Nagpur.In a post on X, Kharge referred to RSS’s history of hoisting the Indian National Flag at its headquarters, saying the RSS did not hoist the Tricolour at its Nagpur headquarters for more than five decades after Independence."For over five decades after Independence, the RSS did not hoist the Indian National Flag at its Nagpur headquarters. The Tricolour was officially hoisted only in 2002," Kharge said in a post on X.He questioned why the organisation had chosen the Bhagwa Dhwaj over the national flag."Before lecturing every Indian on patriotism, perhaps the BJP should first explain why its ideological parent choose the Bhagwa Dhwaj over the Tricolour and why the national flag was absent from its own headquarters for so long," Kharge said.Kharge also questioned the presence of the Indian Tricolour in RSS route marches, asking how many such marches had seen uniformed swayamsevaks carrying the national flag."How many RSS route marches have you seen where swayamsevaks, in full uniform, proudly march carrying the Indian Tricolour? None. And these chaps go around giving “Desh Bhakt” certificates to everyone," Kharge added.Kharge’s remarks came as the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign is underway ahead of Independence Day Launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2022 as part of the Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav, the campaign encourages citizens to hoist the National Flag at their homes and build a personal connection with the Tricolour.
Article Summary: Karnataka home minister Priyank Kharge targeted the BJP over its ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign. He said it should begin at the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh ( RSS ) headquarters in Nagpur. Kharge also questioned the presence of the Indian Tricolour in RSS route marches.

NAGPUR: The 19-year-old Thane youth accused of raping and trying to kill a 16-year-old girl in Nagpur allegedly kept her under “digital arrest” for nearly three months, using mobile phone access, threats and constant video calls to control her, police said Tuesday.The girl was held hostage at a rented flat, raped repeatedly, whipped with a leather belt and inflicted with 20 knife wounds.She was rescued on Aug 3 from the flat in Nagpur’s Dighori area after her parents filed a missing complaint. About two months ago, he allegedly told the girl to go to the terrace of her flat and start a video call.He also ordered her to sleep under her bed. NEW DELHI: Increased ruckus hit Lok Sabha Wednesday after govt told opposition home minister Amit Shah was ready to participate in, and reply to, a discussion on NEET protest — as BJP’s attempt to break the deadlock that has virtually washed out Parliament’s monsoon session came to a naught on the penultimate day.LoP Rahul Gandhi said the country’s younger generation is not interested in Shah’s lecture and imagination, and he should merely tell who ordered use of pellet guns and nail-studded lathis on students.After repeated adjournments, parliamentary affairs minister Kiren Rijiju told LS that Shah has written a letter to the Speaker that a discussion on NEET protest can start immediately, and he would reply. Rijiju urged opposition to sit peacefully for the discussion, saying “the home minister is waiting”.He said just two days were left in the session while the opposition was running away. But opposition intensified sloganeering and jammed the well. Presiding officer Jagdambika Pal repeatedly said he was ready to start the discussion if the members returned to their seats.But opposition was in no mood to relent. Rahul told reporters there was no need for a discussion and Shah should simply tell the House “who gave the order to shoot the students, who shot the students, who gave the order to beat the students with nail-studded lathis”, which would establish if he is culpable or incompetent.Rahul said Shah has been missing from the House for 20 days, even as he came and left Parliament in “30 cars every day”. He claimed there are a thousand cops stationed outside Shah’s residence to ensure no student comes there. “Shah has no courage, his balloon has punctured,” he remarked.On rejecting Shah’s offer of discussion, Congress’s KC Venugopal said Shah did not come to LS during the day. Deputy LoP Gaurav Gogoi accused him of obfuscating the issue by offering a discussion on NEET protest. “The issue was discussed over two days under the debate on ‘unfair means bill’. Only Shah’s reply is pending.”Minutes before the proceedings, the Speaker called Venugopal to ask him about opposition’s response to Shah’s offer for a discussion, and was told opposition was sticking to its demand for a statement by Shah and discussion on Ram temple “Chanda Chori”.Leader of the opposition Rahul Gandhi said the country’s younger generation is not interested in home minister Amit Shah’s lecture and imagination, and he should merely tell who ordered use of pellet guns and nail-studded lathis on student-protesters at Jantar Mantar.

Article Title: Russia appoints former CJI DY Chandrachud as arbitrator in Ukraine's Oschadbank case
Article Text:
File photo: Former CJI Justice DY Chandrachud (Picture credit: PTI)

Dispute concerns Oschadbank assets in four Ukrainian regions

Chandrachud had earlier declined Russia's approaches

Three-member tribunal to hear the case

Russia-Ukraine war sees fresh escalation as Zelenskyy flags North Korean support

Former chief justice of India D Y Chandrachud has been appointed by Russia as its arbitrator in an investment treaty dispute filed by Ukrainian state-owned bank Oschadbank, according to a report by Global Arbitration Review, as cited by Bar and Bench.The dispute is being heard by a three-member arbitral tribunal under the 1998 bilateral investment treaty between Ukraine and Russia.Costa Rican arbitrator and former trade minister Dyalá Jiménez will serve as the tribunal's president after being jointly selected by both parties.Greek arbitrator and National University of Singapore professor Stavros Brekoulakis was appointed by Oschadbank, while Justice Chandrachud was appointed by Russia.Oschadbank's claim concerns assets and operations in Donetsk, Luhansk, Kherson and Zaporizhzhia that the Ukrainian state-owned bank says it lost following Russian military actions in Ukraine, particularly after Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022.The claim is understood to be worth hundreds of millions of dollars. According to Bar and Bench, Oschadbank initiated the arbitration after serving Russia with a notice of dispute in July 2025, which allegedly went unanswered.The proceedings have been initiated under the 1998 Agreement between the Government of the Russian Federation and the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine on the Encouragement and Mutual Protection of Investments.The dispute is separate from an earlier Oschadbank arbitration concerning its operations and assets in Crimea following Russia's 2014 annexation of the peninsula.In that earlier case, a tribunal constituted under the Permanent Court of Arbitration found Russia liable for unlawful expropriation and awarded Oschadbank approximately $1.1 billion in damages, along with interest and arbitration costs.Russia had declined to participate in those proceedings, but the tribunal proceeded under the applicable arbitration rules.Justice Chandrachud had previously declined approaches from Russia to serve as its arbitrator in treaty disputes involving German energy company Wintershall Dea and Ukrainian state energy company Ukrenergo.He had also been designated by the Permanent Court of Arbitration as the appointing authority in the Wintershall proceedings. He later stepped down from that role after disclosing the communications from Russia.His appointment as Russia's arbitrator in the Oschadbank case therefore marks a change from his earlier decision not to accept Russia's approaches in those proceedings.Jiménez, who was jointly selected by Oschadbank and Russia, will preside over the tribunal. Brekoulakis was appointed by Oschadbank, while Justice Chandrachud was appointed by Russia.Oschadbank is represented by Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan partners Epaminontas Triantafilou and Alex Gerbi, along with Asters partners Oleksiy Didkovskiy, Andrii Pozhidayev and Oksana Legka.Russia is represented by Pinna Goldberg partner Andrea Pinna, counsel Pratyush Panjwani and senior associate Dimitrios Papageorgiou.The case comes against the broader backdrop of investment disputes arising from Russia's military actions in Ukraine and the resulting loss of Ukrainian businesses and assets in territories under Russian control.Meanwhile, the Russia-Ukraine war continued to escalate, with at least 10 civilians killed in Russian missile, drone and glide-bomb attacks across Ukraine on Tuesday, according to Ukrainian officials.President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russian forces used North Korean-supplied ballistic missiles in a strike on Zaporizhzhia that killed seven steel plant workers and injured 21 others.Zelenskyy also said North Korea was preparing to deploy additional troops to Russia.Russia, meanwhile, said it intercepted nearly 400 Ukrainian drones, while Ukraine reported strikes on a Russian oil refinery in Orsk and a Ukrainian drone attack in Tatarstan that killed at least 12 people and injured 39 others.The UN also said more than 16,000 Ukrainian civilians detained by Russia remain deprived of their liberty, with reports of continuing torture and ill-treatment.
Article Summary: Former chief justice of India D Y Chandrachud appointed by Russia as arbitrator in investment treaty dispute. Dispute concerns Oschadbank assets in four Ukrainian regions. Three-member tribunal to hear the case under 1998 bilateral investment treaty between Ukraine and Russia.

Article Title: SC orders CBI probe into Chhattisgarh custodial death
Article Text:
It also directed the state govt to pay Rs 25 lakh as interim compensation to the family of the deceased

NEW DELHI: Accusing top administrative and police officials of Chhattisgarh of trying to "cover up" a custodial death case, Supreme Court on Wednesday expressed lack of confidence in the state administration's catching the errant officials and handed over the case to CBI. It also directed the state govt to pay Rs 25 lakh as interim compensation to the family of the deceased.A bench said that the case warranted immediate registration of an FIR and a thorough investigation into the circumstances leading to the death of Shravan Suryavanshi, which the state authorities had "conveniently and deliberately tried to cover up".It said that state authorities were adopting a "dilatory approach" and could not be trusted to conduct an impartial probe. Shravan was arrested on Jan 18, 2024, after he was found in possession of raw Mahua liquor and lodged at Central Jail, Bilaspur, from where he was referred to hospital on Jan 21.He died a day later.Referring to the high court order, bench said the death of the deceased was on account of violence perpetrated on him in custody. In compliance with the court's directive, the DGP, director general (Prisons) and principal secretary (Home), virtually appeared before the court, which found their explanation "perfunctory and pedantic"."In this backdrop, the stance of blissful ignorance taken by the senior officers of the State of Chhattisgarh, including the Principal Secretary (Home), the DGP and the DG (Prisons), is sacrilegious and reflects a disturbing disregard for the statutory procedure governing custodial deaths. The explanation offered that neither any police action nor any disciplinary action was taken against the persons responsible because the judicial inquiry report had not been served upon the police officials is a cover-up story and an attempt to pull the wool over the Court's eyes," bench said."We have seen the medical reports of the deceased Shravan and find that a clear attempt was made to mislead the inquiry because, in the medical report prepared at jail at the time of his death, the cause of death was recorded as cardiopulmonary arrest with aspiration pneumonitis, with the diagnosis being alcoholic withdrawal and delirium tremens," it said.The court thereafter asked CBI director to ensure immediate registration of a regular case over Shravan's custodial death, ordering that the investigation be entrusted to a senior officer and conducted expeditiously. The report of the investigating officer is to be placed before the court on the next date of hearing. It further said that the conduct of state officials concerned in failing to take appropriate steps pursuant to submission of the judicial inquiry report should also be examined and made a part of the investigation.
Article Summary: Supreme Court accuses top administrative and police officials of Chhattisgarh of trying to "cover up" a custodial death case. It said that state authorities were adopting a "dilatory approach" and could not be trusted to conduct an impartial probe. It also directed the state govt to pay Rs 25 lakh as interim compensation to the family of the deceased.

Article Title: NEET-PG aspirants get wrong exam city texts after NBEMS glitch
Article Text:
Several candidates reported receiving two different SMS messages within hours, each mentioning a different test city (representative image)

NEW DELHI: Hundreds of NEET-PG 2026 aspirants were left confused after receiving incorrect SMS alerts about their allotted examination cities, prompting the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) to issue a clarification that a technical glitch had led to wrong messages being sent to some candidates.Several candidates reported receiving two different SMSes within hours, each mentioning a different test city. In one such case, an aspirant was first allotted Gudur (Andhra Pradesh) and later received another message assigning Noida (Uttar Pradesh) as the examination city.In a public notice issued on Wednesday, NBEMS said the test city allocation had been completed as scheduled and uploaded on the official applicant portal. However, "due to some technical issues", the test city conveyed to some candidates through SMS was incorrect. It said fresh SMSes and emails carrying the correct test city had subsequently been sent to the affected candidates.The Board advised candidates not to rely on SMS messages and instead verify their allotted examination city through the NBEMS applicant portal, which it said contains the correct details for all candidates.It also urged aspirants to rely only on official communications and beware of fake websites and misinformation.The clarification comes just days before the conduct of the national postgraduate medical entrance examination, with candidates already making travel and accommodation arrangements based on their allotted test cities. The confusion triggered anxiety among aspirants, many of whom took to social media to seek clarification after receiving conflicting messages.NBEMS maintained that the applicant portal carries the correct examination city details and asked candidates to refer to it for authentic information. It said corrected SMSes and emails have been issued wherever required.
Article Summary: Hundreds of NEET-PG 2026 aspirants left confused after receiving incorrect SMS alerts about their allotted examination cities. National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences says technical glitch led to wrong messages being sent to some candidates. Candidates reported receiving two different SMSes within hours, each mentioning a different test city.

Article Title: J&K SIA reopens probe into 1990 killings of Kashmiri Pandit poet, nurse
Article Text:
On June 29, SIA filed a chargesheet in the abduction, torture and killing of Bhat

SRINAGAR: Sarvanand Kaul Premi was a poet. Sarla Bhat was a nurse. Both were Kashmiri Pandits who stayed behind when militancy erupted and were killed in 1990. More than three decades later, J&K police’s SIA revived unresolved cases from the Valley’s darkest years. The agency searched Wednesday nine locations in its probe into the abduction-murder of Premi and his younger son, weeks after filing a chargesheet in Bhat’s killing.Premi, 66, a poet, teacher and Gandhian, and Verinder were abducted from their village, Soaf Shali near Kokernag, on Apr 30, 1990. They were shot dead the next day. Five days later, the grief-stricken Kaul family left Kashmir, never to return.State Investigation Agency’s searches were linked to FIR No. 45/1990 registered at Dooru police station in Anantnag. SIA is pursuing militancy-era cases that had lain cold for decades.On June 29, SIA filed a chargesheet in the abduction, torture and killing of Bhat, 27, a staff nurse in the neonatology ward at Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences in Srinagar. She was allegedly abducted by JKLF from SKIMS Habba Khatoon Hostel on Apr 18, 1990, and taken to Illahibagh-Lal Bazar, tortured and shot dead.Her bullet-riddled body was found the next day at Omer Colony Malabagh in downtown Srinagar.Born in Soaf Shali in 1924, Premi joined Khadi Bhandar after completing his education and became associated with Mahatma Gandhi’s Swadeshi movement. His association with Kashmiri poet Ghulam Ahmad Mahjoor inspired his literary career. He translated Rabindranath Tagore’s “Gitanjali” into Kashmiri and the Bhagavad Gita and Ramayana into Kashmiri and Urdu, and advocated secularism and interfaith harmony.J&K govt under then-CM Farooq Abdullah posthumously awarded Premi a gold medal in 1997 for his contribution to Kashmiri literature and communal harmony.The killings from Kashmir’s violent spring of 1990 were part of a wider wave of hostility against Kashmiri Pandits after militancy erupted, driving a mass exodus of the community from the Valley. In 2010, J&K govt under then-CM Omar Abdullah told the assembly that 209 Kashmiri Pandits had been murdered since 1990, according to Kasmiri Pandit organisations.
Article Summary: Kashmiri Pandits Sarvanand Kaul Premi and Verinder were abducted and shot dead in 1990. J&K police’s SIA revived unresolved cases from the Valley's darkest years. On June 29, SIA filed a chargesheet in the abduction, torture and killing of Bhat.

Article Title: China says India border 'generally stable' amid tensions in Arunachal
Article Text:
China said the India-China border remains “generally stable” while sidestepping reports of increased Chinese military activity near Arunachal Pradesh.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

China said Wednesday that the situation along the India-China border was “generally stable at the moment”, while declining to confirm reports of increased Chinese military activity in disputed areas near Arunachal Pradesh.Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun made the remarks at a regular press briefing in Beijing in response to questions about videos circulating on Indian social media that purportedly showed heightened Chinese military activity along the border.Guo said China and India had held the 36th meeting of the Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination on Border Affairs the previous week. He said both sides had agreed to maintain communication through diplomatic and military channels and work together to preserve peace and tranquillity along the border.The comments came a day after India reiterated that its border with China remained a matter of serious concern and that maintaining peace and tranquillity along the Line of Actual Control was essential to the broader relationship between the two countries.The Chinese response also came amid reports of heightened military activity by Chinese troops in Arunachal Pradesh’s Upper Subansiri region. Beijing claims Arunachal Pradesh as part of what it calls “South Tibet”, a claim consistently rejected by New Delhi.India had separately pushed back against China’s objections to New Delhi formally identifying 27 locations and geographical features in Arunachal Pradesh by their standard Indian names. The Ministry of External Affairs said the state was an “inalienable and integral” part of India and that nothing could change that reality.The latest exchanges come as India and China continue efforts to stabilise ties that deteriorated sharply after the 2020 Galwan Valley clashes and a prolonged military standoff along the border.The two countries reached a disengagement agreement covering the remaining friction points at Depsang and Demchok in October 2024.Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping subsequently held talks in Kazan, followed by further diplomatic efforts aimed at improving bilateral relations.
Article Summary: China declines to confirm reports of increased Chinese military activity in disputed areas near Arunachal Pradesh. China and India have agreed to maintain communication through diplomatic and military channels and work together to preserve peace and tranquillity along the border. India reiterated that its border with China remained a matter of serious concern.

Article Title: Delhi Police’s ‘Kuchu Puchu’ Gen-Z twist to warn Delhiites about Chinese manjha
Article Text:
Chinese manjha is generally made using synthetic or plastic material.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Delhi Police has found a rather unusual way to join the viral ‘kuchu-puchu’ Gen Z trend, using internet humour to deliver a serious warning about kite-flying strings.In a recent social media post, the police urged residents to enjoy kite flying but stay away from banned Chinese manjha and plastic-coated strings, which can cause serious injuries to people and animals.“Dear Kuchu Puchu, Patang Udao but Say NO to Chinese Manjha, Samjhe?” the police wrote, giving its usual safety messaging a more playful, social media-friendly tone.The message comes as authorities step up action against the banned string in Delhi. The Crime Branch recently seized more than 1,300 rolls of Chinese manjha during an enforcement operation. In a separate action, Central Delhi Police recovered around 120 rolls.The post quickly drew reactions online, with some users poking fun at the police for adopting the language of Gen Z.“Gen-Z mode of Delhi Police”, “They are updating”, some comments read. Behind the light-hearted presentation, however, is a serious safety concern.Chinese manjha is generally made using synthetic or plastic material and can be coated with abrasive substances. Because of its sharpness, it can cause deep cuts and injuries.It can also become particularly dangerous for birds, which can get caught in the string while flying. There have already been fatal consequences in Delhi.Recently, a 32-year-old man travelling to Mundka for business suffered a cut to his neck after coming into contact with Chinese manjha in southwest Delhi's Uttam Nagar.In another tragic incident in 2023, a seven-year-old girl died after being injured by Chinese manjha while travelling with her father on a scooter in west Delhi's Paschim Vihar.The police's latest post therefore carries a straightforward message beneath all the social media humour. People can continue flying kites and enjoying the activity, but using banned synthetic strings can put lives at risk.The campaign also reflects a broader change in the way police departments communicate with the public, with serious safety warnings increasingly being delivered through the language, trends and humour that dominate social media.
Article Summary: Delhi Police use internet humour to deliver serious warning about kite-flying strings. Chinese manjha is generally made using synthetic or plastic material. Because of its sharpness, it can cause deep cuts and injuries. It can also become particularly dangerous for birds, which can get caught in the string.

I will sit in the House; I will listen to everyone and respond to every point. Yet, some ask me to simply make a statement. Such a serious issue cannot be discussed in that manner. That may be your method, but it is not the parliamentary way. In Parliament, discussions are held at length," he said."In Parliament, discussions are held at length. I am ready for the debate to continue from 3:00 PM today, sitting late into the night and continuing until 3:00 PM tomorrow; I am even prepared to suspend the Question Hour if the Speaker grants permission," Shah said."I am ready for the discussion to go on until 3:00 PM tomorrow. I will sit through it myself, take notes on everything, and respond to every point so that the entire matter becomes clear to the people of the country—so that the truth is fully revealed. Now, the Opposition must decide whether they want to engage in a discussion or create an uproar," he added.Congress leader Rahul Gandhi rejected Shah's offer, saying the opposition was seeking answers on the alleged police action against students rather than a lecture from the home minister."The opposition has clearly said that we are not interested in Amit Shah giving us a lecture. When I say 'we', I mean the younger generation of this country. Who shot the students? Who gave the order to beat up the students with lathis with nails? Did Amit Shah give this order to shoot our children? If he did, then he should resign. For the last 20 days, Amit Shah has been missing. The Home Minister of India has no courage; he cannot come to the House," Rahul said."Did home minister Shah give orders to shoot our children or not; if he did, he is culpable and if he did not, he is incompetent," he added.The leader of opposition also took to X, sharing a video of his remark saying "When a man lacks the courage to speak the truth, his silence speaks for him. Amit Shah’s silence is his confession."The opposition has been demanding Shah's presence in Parliament and a statement on the "police action" against students during the Jantar Mantar protest.Earlier in the day, opposition MPs, including Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge and party general secretary Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, staged a protest in the Parliament House Complex over the alleged theft of donations at the Ram temple in Ayodhya and the alleged police excesses against student protesters.Priyanka also questioned the government over the alleged use of force against students.The INDIA bloc has been protesting for more than three weeks, demanding Shah's presence in the House and a statement from him.Earlier on Monday, Kiren Rijiju said the government was ready for a detailed discussion on the student protests and urged the opposition not to disrupt proceedings when Shah responds."The offer made by the government is very clear that it is ready to have a full and detailed discussion on students' movement and activities related to it," Rijiju said."My only point made to the opposition is that while the discussion and a reply are being made, the opposition should not create disturbances to prevent the statement of the home minister," he said, adding that, "They must listen to the reply of the home minister and the government. Once discussion begins, we must have a threadbare discussion."Rijiju's remarks came after Rahul criticised the Centre over the alleged police action during the July 20 student protests at Jantar Mantar and demanded a court-monitored probe. Parliament proceedings have repeatedly been disrupted during the Monsoon Session, with several Bills passed by the Lok Sabha amid the continuing deadlock.

NEW DELHI: Tamil Nadu assembly on Wednesday passed a special resolution in the urging the Centre to permanently retain the Lok Sabha’s strength at 543 seats.Days after convening a meeting of parties supporting his government, including the Congress and the Left parties that extend support from outside, CM Vijay moved the resolution in the assembly urging the Centre to maintain the Lok Sabha-Rajya Sabha seat ratio at 2.2:1.The government-sponsored resolution urged the Centre to implement 33 per cent reservation for women in the 2029 Lok Sabha elections without delay, based on the existing strength of 543 seats."The 33% reservation for women should be implemented in the 2029 Lok Sabha elections itself, based on the existing 543 constituencies. The 33% reservation for women should not be delayed any further. In Tamil Nadu, more women have voted than men. Providing reservation for women is not a concession; it is a matter of social justice. The 33% reservation for women must be implemented without any further delay," Vijay said in the assembly.The resolution noted that the population of states, including Tamil Nadu, and the Union Territories has not been counted for more than five decades, with the next census scheduled for 2026."All the states including Tamil Nadu and the people / elected representatives of the union territories have not had their population counted for more than 50 years.The next census to count the population was supposed to be held in 2026. Therefore, since the delimitation of constituencies has not been carried out for the last 50 years, based on the 2011 population census, the constituencies should be delimited and the number of Lok Sabha and Assembly members should be increased from 550 to 850 by bringing in a constitutional amendment Bill," the resolution stated.Last week, a meeting convened by Vijay with Tamil Nadu MPs from alliance and friendly parties decided to oppose the Union government’s proposed delimitation exercise in its entirety.The meeting was boycotted by the main opposition DMK and the AIADMK, with the former calling the deliberations a “farce” and the latter describing them as a “hurriedly staged drama”.The MPs had demanded that the ratio of seats between the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha be maintained at 2.2:1. They also unanimously agreed to adopt a resolution in the state Assembly to permanently safeguard the interests of Tamil Nadu and other southern states in the delimitation process.Meanwhile, the AIADMK called the meeting a “hurriedly staged drama”, pointing out that no fresh delimitation Bill had been introduced in Parliament and that there had been no official announcement on the exercise.While the Congress and other opposition parties have supported the Women's Reservation Bill, they have opposed linking its implementation to the delimitation exercise and have demanded that the two be delinked.The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, 2023, was passed by both Houses of Parliament. However, its implementation has not moved forward after the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill fell in the Lok Sabha on April 17, failing to secure the constitutionally required two-thirds majority of members present and voting.The Bill had linked the implementation of 33% reservation for women in legislatures to the delimitation of Lok Sabha constituencies.
Article Summary: Tamil Nadu assembly backs 543 Lok Sabha seat freeze. Government-sponsored resolution urges Centre to implement 33 per cent reservation for women in 2029 Lok Sabha elections. Meeting boycotted by main opposition DMK and the AIADMK, with the former calling deliberations a ‘farce’
